name: continuity-plane
description: Zero-friction bounded recovery and checkpoint canaries for Codex

interface.shortDescription: 压缩前后保持任务连续 / Preserve work across compaction.
interface.longDescription: 在压缩前创建 checkpoint，压缩后先验证 canary，再以有界恢复包继续当前 Work。 Creates a checkpoint before compaction, verifies it afterward, and resumes from a bounded packet.
defaultPrompt: 检查当前项目的连续性状态。
